global_findings: All 28 pinned source blob SHAs resolve exactly at the specified base commit. This proves provenance, not that archived results were independently regenerated.
Cleveland D-047 and UCI-412 M3a each have n=303 but are distinct cohorts and outcome definitions; their metrics must not be ranked as a common benchmark.
Reported ± values are descriptive standard deviations over four dependent repeated-CV runs, not confidence intervals and not independent-sample uncertainty estimates.
Cleveland outcome-proportion sample-size target is 382 (and MAPE criterion 459); n=303 is inadequate at stated half-width. UCI-412 target 315; n=303 below it; R²-dependent criteria not assessed.
Calibration slopes/CITL are descriptive, with estimability limitations; they do not prove clinical calibration or medical reliability.
Genuine SHAP/LIME are offline research implementations; live backend exposes only mock synthetic provider. No explanation is clinical evidence.
No real Hungary assessment, real external validation, patient-facing clinical use, supervisor signoff, or final release acceptance is established.
scientific_status: Historical source numbers are faithfully attributed as archived reports; not rerun in this task. No fully verified correction identified from blob/coverage cross-check. Human source-level scientific review remains required.
